full_prompt_en: A square oil painting in a densely detailed historical realist style shows a bearded man and a woman behind a market stall piled high with fruit and vegetables. The background is almost completely covered by hanging foliage, woven baskets, and tightly packed produce, leaving only small dark recesses between the goods. At the upper left, a basket of clustered reddish fruit sits behind the man's cap. Near the upper center, a broad basket holds small warm orange fruits, pale roots, and greens, with other baskets receding into the shadow around it. The man occupies the left half of the image. He wears a soft brown cap and a heavy brown outer garment, and his long dark beard falls across his chest. His face turns slightly toward the left edge, away from the woman, with a serious, absorbed expression. Beside him on the right, the woman wears a folded white head covering, a pale scarf around her neck, and a muted brick-red bodice. Her head tilts toward the display; her gaze rests downward and to the left rather than meeting the viewer. In the foreground, leafy greens rise before the man, while broad heaps of red grapes, apples, pears, pale gourds, and brown roots crowd the lower half. A large pale gourd sits near the lower center, with red apples and yellow fruit arranged in front of it. The dense objects overlap so thoroughly that the lower edge becomes a continuous band of rounded fruit, rough leaves, and knotted stems. Fine painted highlights describe waxy fruit skins, papery leaves, woven wicker, and the folds of cloth without flattening their different textures. Warm light from the upper left catches faces, white fabric, and the nearest fruit, while the baskets behind sink into deep olive-brown shadow. The overall composition is crowded and richly layered, with earthy reds and greens held together by warm chiaroscuro and meticulous surface detail.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、细节密集的历史写实油画描绘一名蓄须男子与一名女子，站在堆满水果和蔬菜的集市摊位后。背景几乎被垂挂的枝叶、编织篮筐和紧密堆放的果蔬填满，货物之间只留下小块幽暗空隙。左上方，一篮成串的红色果实位于男子帽子后。靠近上方中央，宽口篮筐盛着小颗暖橙色果实、浅色根茎和绿叶，周围还有篮筐退入阴影。男子占据画面左半边，戴软棕帽，穿厚重的棕色外衣，长长的深色胡须垂过胸前。他的脸微微转向左缘，没有看向女子，神情严肃而专注。右侧女子戴层叠的白色头巾，浅色围巾裹住颈部，身穿暗砖红色上衣。她的头向陈列的货物倾斜，目光落在左下方，而非看向观者。前景中，叶菜在男子面前升起，大片红葡萄、苹果、梨、浅色葫芦和棕色根茎挤满下半部。一只大浅色葫芦位于下部中央附近，前面排着红苹果和黄果。密集的物件充分遮叠，让下缘连成一条由圆润果实、粗糙叶片和纠结茎秆组成的连续带。细致的绘画高光描摹果皮的蜡质光泽、薄叶、编织柳条与布料褶皱，同时保留各自不同的质地。暖光从左上方照亮面孔、白色布料与近处水果，后方篮筐则沉入深橄榄棕色阴影。整体构图拥挤而层次丰厚，以暖色明暗对照和细密表面描写串联土红与深绿。
style_prompt_en: The oil-painted surface is built from dense overlapping forms, careful tonal modeling, and many small material distinctions. Earthy brick red, ocher, deep olive green, warm cream, and umber fill nearly the whole frame, with little empty background. Rounded volumes press against rougher branching and folded shapes, creating a compact rhythm of curves and irregular edges. Fine highlights pick out glossy, dry, fibrous, and woven surfaces in separate ways, so density remains legible rather than turning into one texture. Warm directional light reaches the forward planes and pale accents, while recessed areas fall into deep brown-green shadow. The depth develops through occlusion and a gradual loss of detail toward the back, even though the frame feels tightly packed. Edges range from crisp on illuminated surfaces to soft and partly swallowed in dark passages. The overall effect is abundant, tactile, and dramatic, balancing meticulous realism with a compressed, shadow-rich arrangement.
style_prompt_zh: 油画表面由密集遮叠的形体、仔细的明暗塑形和许多细小的材质差别构成。土砖红、赭黄、深橄榄绿、暖奶油色与棕褐色几乎铺满画幅，空白背景很少。圆润体积挤压着较粗糙的分枝和褶叠形态，形成由曲线与不规则边缘组成的紧凑节奏。细小高光以不同方式点出光泽、干燥、纤维和编织表面，使密度仍可辨认，而不会化为单一纹理。暖色定向光照到靠前的色面与浅色重音，后退的区域沉入深棕绿色阴影。尽管画面显得紧密拥挤，空间仍通过遮挡和向后逐渐减少的细节展开。受光表面边缘清晰，暗部边缘则柔和且部分被吞没。整体效果丰盛、可触而富有戏剧性，在细密写实与压缩的深影布局之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A bearded market seller and a woman behind a lavish produce stall
theme_zh: 丰盛果蔬摊位后的蓄须摊贩与女子
name: Joachim Beuckelaer
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
